content = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=1608, access_token=simple_access_token)['content']
# Extract movie titles with explicit 'director: David Fincher'
import re
# Pattern: Title line, then later a '- director: David Fincher' line before next blank line or next title
blocks = re.split(r"\n\n+", content.strip())
fincher_titles=[]
for b in blocks:
    lines=[ln.strip() for ln in b.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
    if not lines: 
        continue
    title=lines[0]
    # Look for director line containing David Fincher
    director_lines=[ln for ln in lines[1:] if ln.startswith('- director:')]
    if any('David Fincher' in ln for ln in director_lines):
        fincher_titles.append(title)
print('fincher_titles', fincher_titles)
print('count', len(fincher_titles))
